integrity: The infinite upper bound is analytic. The bundled exact Q(sqrt(3)) checker verifies only the finite dual-facet table, feasible-polygon vertices, and attaining pair used by the proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem evaluates the Yang--Li P-angle formula only on the canonical regular dodecagonal plane; it does not classify arbitrary regular polygons or all polyhedral Banach planes. The defining preprint has an earlier standing dimension convention, although Definition 3.1 itself is stated for a Banach space and its following remark explicitly treats the two-dimensional Euclidean plane.
title: Exact P-angle constant of the regular dodecagonal Banach plane
